text: Day 1. The pod is dead. Three of us made it. The sun is small and very far away.
We dragged the wreckage into a pit and started sorting. It feels like a beginning.
Five now. Stragglers keep walking in from the dunes, following our smoke.
First deep winter. The air hurts. Keep the barrels burning.
The flight computer boots. Its clock says we have been asleep for a very long time.
First metal from the smelter. Ugly, porous, ours.
Twelve. Somebody painted a name on the main shelter: Aphelion. The farthest point from the sun.
The first hand-etched circuit works on the third try. The scholars cheer.
The colony votes on a charter. Not everyone agrees on what we are for.
The reactor core hums in its cradle. The engineers won't stop staring at it.
Ignition. For one second, our little star is brighter than the real one.
